newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rise early ahead of option settlement.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rise early ahead of option settlement.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose in early morning trade on Friday on buying related to the day's "special quotation" settlement of April stock options, brokers said.

Shares in Nippon Credit Bank Ltd, which announced on Thursday that it and Bankers Trust New York Corp had agreed on a business tie-up, were bid-only, helping to lift market sentiment slightly, they said.
At 0019 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 79.21 points, or 0.45 percent, at 17,564.96. June Nikkei futures rose 60 points to 17,550.
